author: China Insights
description:
For years, Li Zhanshu was one of Xi Jinping's most trusted political allies—a man who survived repeated controversies and rose to become China's third-highest-ranking official.

Now, new rumors surrounding his daughter, Li Qianxin, and her business connections in Hong Kong have brought renewed attention to the former Chinese leader's family.

How did Li Zhanshu rise from a provincial official to the heart of Xi Jinping's inner circle? What do past investigations reveal about his family's business interests? And why are questions about his political future resurfacing now?

In this episode, we trace Li Zhanshu's remarkable rise, the controversies surrounding his family, and the political tensions behind Beijing's closed doors.

We also examine the speculation surrounding actress Tong Liya and her changing career. What is documented, and what remains rumor?
